_meta.description: FIFA Fan Festivals, weather and transit tips for WC26 host cities.

fan_festivals.overview: Official FIFA Fan Festival staged in 13 host cities (a tournament record), most running all 39 days June 11 - July 19, free entry, with giant-screen match broadcasts, concerts/DJ sets, food and soccer activations.

confirmed_sites.Monterrey: Parque Fundidora (80-hectare urban park, all 39 days)
confirmed_sites.Toronto: Fort York National Historic Site & The Bentway
confirmed_sites.Philadelphia: Lemon Hill, East Fairmount Park (all 39 days)
confirmed_sites.New York / New Jersey: Original Liberty State Park site cancelled Feb 2026; replaced by Fan Zone Queens at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center (Jun 17-28) and Fan Village Rockefeller Center (Jul 4-19)

tbd_sites.Miami: TBD - not confirmed in verified sources this session
tbd_sites.Seattle: TBD - not confirmed in verified sources this session
tbd_sites.San Francisco Bay Area: TBD - not confirmed in verified sources this session

weather_june_july.highest_heat_risk: Dallas, Houston, Miami, Monterrey regularly hit dangerous humid-heat levels (wet-bulb 28C+). Forecasters expect an unusually hot summer.
weather_june_july.Houston: Worst heat+humidity combo of any host city; low-mid 90s F with dew points in the 70s - but matches are indoors with AC.
weather_june_july.Dallas_Arlington: Afternoon WBGT frequently exceeds 82.4 F / 28 C; matches indoors with AC.
weather_june_july.Miami: Highs ~90 F, average heat index ~102 F; most matches late afternoon.
weather_june_july.Monterrey: Low-mid 90s F typical, occasional extremes to 110s.
weather_june_july.New_York_New_Jersey: Meadowlands averages ~18 days of 90 F+ across June-July.
weather_june_july.Atlanta: Hot, humid southern-inland city (30C+ common) - stadium has roof and AC.
weather_june_july.Mexico_City: Mild thanks to 7,200 ft altitude (rarely 90 F); thin air a bigger factor than heat.
weather_june_july.Guadalajara: Early-season tropical moisture possible (Tropical Storm Boris brought 1-2 in of rain just before the opener).
weather_june_july.Vancouver: Most comfortable host city: mid-60s to low-70s F, low humidity.
weather_june_july.Toronto_Boston: Northern cities - relatively mild, with occasional hot spells.
weather_june_july.Los_Angeles_San_Francisco: Mild mid-60s to low-70s F, cool evenings, SF morning fog - the exceptions to the heat trend.

shuttle_or_car_dependent: Guadalajara (BRT or FIFA Ride al Estadio shuttle + walk)

money_savers.Philadelphia: SEPTA $2.90 to the stadium and FREE rides home after matches - cheapest big-city option.
money_savers.Atlanta: MARTA kept standard fares; ~$5 round trip.
money_savers.Seattle: ORCA 3-Day World Cup Pass: $18 unlimited regional transit.
money_savers.Guadalajara: All transit unified at 11 pesos/ride; buy a 30-peso Mi Movilidad card (many stations cashless).
money_savers.Mexico_City: Metro + Tren Ligero to Azteca costs only a few pesos (~25 pesos from airport, ~90 min).
money_savers.Boston_warning: Foxboro Stadium Train is $80 round trip - book mTicket early; driving parking is worse.
money_savers.NYNJ_warning: NJ Transit stadium round trip is $105, capped at 40,000 riders, app pre-purchase + return wristband mandatory - buy the moment your match is confirmed.
money_savers.Dallas_LA_Miami_KC: Budget extra time and money: these venues need shuttle transfers or rideshare/car.
